resources.string: Draws the replacement climate and navigation bar over the factory bar, and provides its Home and Back actions.
The bar has replaced the factory one at the bottom of the screen. To turn it off, disable this service under Settings → Accessibility — the factory bar comes straight back.
Enable “WK2 Climate” under Settings → Accessibility. If Android warns about a restricted setting, open App info for this app, choose “Allow restricted settings” from its menu, then try again.

This ROM has no accessibility settings screen, so the service has to be enabled over adb. Append this service to enabled_accessibility_services — append, never overwrite, or the services already listed will stop working.
Waiting for the head unit to report its canbus setting. This takes a moment after the climate bar service starts.
Read from the head unit’s own canbus setting. If this is not your car, change the canbus setting on the head unit, not here.
The head unit reports a canbus id that has no climate profile we can trust. The factory climate bar stays as it is.
Do your front seats have heating?
Look for a seat with wavy lines on the seat button.
Do your front seats have cooling?
Sometimes called ventilated seats. Look for a fan symbol on the seat button.
Does your steering wheel have heating?
Can the driver and passenger set different temperatures?
Your climate bar is live at the bottom of the screen. Changes here save as you make them.
